campaign_window.sequences: One record one tilt RMSE, then equal record macro. Compare identical native scoring indices, one global model plus fixed default full 6D VQF. A tie is not a win.
campaign_window.training_scope: External datasets only. No SHICE fitting, normalization or calibration. Use R1–R4 for development, archive prior R5/R6 exposure. All currently hidden partitions sealed until a final lock. Quantify source-fitted versus reserved evaluation separately.
campaign_window.coordination: Original chat executes one named small batch per decision. Coordinator reproduces and reviews evidence, then decides the next change. Same checkpoint/policy for every dataset, no dataset-ID or label-based routing.
campaign_window.ranking: Prefer more development datasets with lower paired macro RMSE, then minimize largest relative regression, then compare mean relative change; missing datasets or unsupported reference cannot count as wins. Final claims require complete stated scope, with individual wins/losses and neutral/inconclusive labelled.

selection_basis: Only the 213-record common development panel. More strictly improving domains first, then lower worst candidate/default domain-mean ratio, then lower mean ratio. Record counts for missing policies shown separately. A physical ablation has neither weights nor components.

selected.label: 取 C023 与 C035 的 50 个历史响应权重的逐元素中点，保留共同的归一化和物理前端

secondary: Same frozen front end and physical terms, with all learned tangents zero. No final result used to choose a model.
metric: Native frames shared with FullVQF; record tilt-angle RMSE in degrees, arithmetic mean across records within domain.
